reviewer: root coordinator; financial batch12 evidence independently challenged against source
title: Owner dashboard stock sum versus signed inventory balance
scope: Compare the owner-dashboard stock projection with shared inventory balance and inventory-overview projections and verify the positive-magnitude Out convention. Narrow static comparison of the active query/command path.
decision: SOURCE-CONFIRMED SEMANTIC DIVERGENCE; same canonical defect FIN-013, no new finding. LoadStockAsync sums QuantityMilliUnits for every movement without applying Direction. InventoryRules.StockBalanceMilliUnits and InventoryQueryService.GetInventoryOverviewAsync add In and subtract Out. RecordWasteHandler stores positive quantity with Direction=Out. Example: 10,000 In + 2,000 Out produces 12,000 on dashboard versus 8,000 in inventory overview; an existing integration test asserts the 8,000 inventory balance. Dashboard may therefore suppress a low-stock warning.

behavior.shared: Movement quantity is a positive magnitude; Direction encodes sign. InventoryOverview and domain balance use signed direction.
behavior.divergent: Owner dashboard sums unsigned movement magnitudes and applies its minimum threshold to the incorrect balance.
behavior.counterevidence: FIN-013 already documents the same code and root cause, so no duplicate finding. The existing vertical-slice test validates inventory overview but does not compare dashboard output. The test was inspected only and not run.
behavior.intent: No evidence that the divergence is intentional; source comment claims both views use the same low-stock test, which is contradicted by implementation.

recommendation: Keep FIN-013 canonical. Align dashboard aggregation with the domain signed-balance invariant or a SQL equivalent; verify parity of low-stock rules between projections before refactoring.
required_tests: Compare dashboard and inventory overview balances after 10,000 In and positive 2,000 Out movements.
Set minimum between the signed and unsigned totals; assert both views agree on low-stock count and item set.
Exercise waste, spoilage, breakage, usage and count-adjustment Out paths.

source_references.evidence: Raw aggregate adds movement magnitudes without Direction.
Shared balance signs In positive and all other Directions negative.
Overview projection signs movement quantities before low-stock test; detail read returns same overview balance.
Waste handler requires positive input and persists Direction=Out with positive QuantityMilliUnits.
Existing integration assertion expects 10,000 In minus 2,000 Out to yield 8,000.

limits: No runtime/integration test executed in this review.
No database write or source modification.
This comparison is limited to current owner-dashboard and inventory-overview balance paths; broader stock valuation/costing parity remains in financial reports.
